question: How much will Gold Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: overlapping 10-trading-day windows of front-month gold futures return minus S&P 500 return, Sep 2024-Sep 2026 (Yahoo weekly closes). Mean 2-week spread over 2y is about +0.4pp, but the trailing 12 months are about -0.4pp per window (gold flat, S&P +10%), so I center near zero rather than extrapolating the 2024-25 gold bull run. Dispersion, not drift, dominates a 10-day horizon: GVZ at 25.7-28.5 is historically elevated while VIX sits near 16, giving a spread SD around 4.7pp with fat tails, and 2026 has already produced windows near +11.5 and -7.7. The window (Sep 21-Oct 2) starts after the Sep 15-16 FOMC hike is absorbed but contains PCE, quarter-end, an Oct 1 funding deadline and a live Middle East/oil shock; escalation lifts gold vs stocks, the de-escalation Trump floated on Sep 13 does the reverse. Slight right skew because gold is the higher-vol leg with crisis upside; no human market prices this spread (Kalshi's new GOLDPERP has no S&P leg or fixed window), so the number is base-rate plus vol, not crowd-anchored.
